invariant.payload_domains: D1 and D3-D9 are payload/value/identity domains, never source delimiters
invariant.transport_rule: transport framing metadata is private mechanism state, never Core.D2 semantic identity

paths.claim: Canonical visible-binary reader consumes W2 structurally with exact 00/01/10/11 roles; W1 and W3-W9 are payload identities.
Source lexer preserves exact W1-W9 width; W2 is a typed two-bit source word and receives no competing structural semantics here.
Migration emits D2 10/00/11/01 for list structure and rejects two-bit words as executable heads or ordinary data.
Surface translation skips display-only structural labels; it never rewrites D2 open/close/separator/dot as human semantic tokens.
Dense packing carries exact source bits only; structural bit patterns are payload and framing/word-boundary metadata stays caller-owned and separate.

Standalone transport framing is already documented as non-semantic, but current main still names private 2-bit tags CONTROL_* and retains stale 'canonical Control2' wording. #4164 renames them WIRE_* and explicitly separates D2:11 DOT from wire escape.

release_rule: For l0.42.0 the owned debt must be resolved by #4164 before release freeze; this audit must never be satisfied by reclassifying transport tags as D2.
